limits: No in-game play test of this PGO build yet: the owner tests it in game (both games); the packaging step builds the installer and the portable zip.
The profile is private and stays outside git (it holds only hashes and counts, of code translated from the game).

The list is the TASK-205 mapping (644 keys, 100 new, 204 signatures) expanded at prepare time over the session's render scale (TASK-206); the 4x gates and the identity gates against the rc15 PGO builds are the headless evidence.
The kit carries no gt4-gs package: this is a CoreGS 2.0 build and the launcher downloads gt4-gs into its data folder when the PCSX2 GS renderer is selected (decision 0070).
The prepare is mandatory for specialised pipelines: a failed or skipped prepare leaves every variant on the uber pipeline (same pixels, more fragment cost) until the next Play's prepare.

A cache prepared for another render scale is refused on purpose (the scale is in the stamp): after changing the Render scale the first session draws with uber and records, and the next Play prepares at the new scale.

A quarantined variant stays on the uber pipeline on this card and driver (its pixels are the same); the way back is deleting the shader cache folder's quarantine.bin (the launcher's support log lists it).
